title: Sweep Config
description: sweep-config/v1 (stack ADR-078 spec S5.3, phase 1). Per-repo config declaring which Sweep families run, at what mode, and with what reasoned exclusions/skips. There is no `enabled` key anywhere in this schema [RT-5] - presence of a family block means the check runs; the only way to not run a check is a `skips` entry with a reason. Phase 1 ships only mode/check_modes/surfaces/families/skips and the A1/A2/A4/E1/B3/B4 family blocks, plus PC1 (2026-08-18 new-user-setup-rev2 plan, task 6 - vendored portable-core skill drift, ADR-075; not one of the spec’s phase-1-3 A-G families, added on top). PC1 must be declarable: it is in the shared scripts/sweep/inventory.txt, so a repo with no legal way to declare it would find its required B5 gate reddening at every stack-pin bump with no remedy but skips-forever. `connections` and the C2/C3/D0a/D0b blocks are added in the phase they are first used (spec S4.4 scope discipline).

schema.description: Schema identifier and version tag for this config. Always the literal string sweep-config/v1.

mode.description: Global ceiling mode. No check_modes entry may sit above this ladder level.

check_modes.description: Per-check mode overrides, keyed by check id. Never above the ladder's earned level (mode).

surfaces.description: System surface classification per declared check id. Required per declared check (spec S5.3). Values reuse the closed enum from finding-record.json's surface field, minus null (a config declaration is never unset).

families.description: Phase-1 family blocks only. Presence of a block means the check runs; there is no enabled key.

migrations_glob.description: OPTIONAL. Glob (a directory plus a single `*` basename pattern) the column universe is parsed from - CREATE TABLE / ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN statements for the declared tables (spec S4.6 A4's degraded, static-source universe). Defaults to "supabase/migrations/*.sql" when absent.

A5.description: command-has-interface-caller (audit #4, ADR-082 P1a). command_map is a single "path#exportSymbol" anchored entry (A2's shape) naming the exported object literal whose top-level string keys ARE the derived universe of command ids - never a hand-kept id list. exclusions is keyed `id`, not `unit` (this family's own stated shape).

min_expected_commands.description: Universe floor. An extracted command-id count below this is a liveness failure (status: error) - an extraction pattern that cannot resolve the map (e.g. dynamic/computed keys) never fakes a smaller universe.

empty_universe_ok.description: OPTIONAL, B4 only. B4's universe is every commit that landed on main in the last 30 days (first-parent). A repo that genuinely had no landings in that window reports universe_size 0, which invariant 2 (default-closed) turns into a liveness failure - correct for a check whose selection broke, wrong for a quiet repo. Declaring this key makes universe 0 a LEGAL SKIP for B4, recorded with this reason. It is a string and never a boolean: the reason is the entire point, and a boolean here would be the `enabled` flag wearing a new name [RT-5]. Absent, universe 0 stays exit 2.

B4.description: B4 (a commit landing on main produces a push-triggered run). Only optional key is empty_universe_ok.

PC1.description: PC1 (vendored .claude/skills/ portable-core copies drifted from config/portable-core-manifest.json, ADR-075). No GitHub API knobs, no app knobs - it reads the manifest and the repo's own .claude/skills/ tree, both local. Declared with an empty object, the same minimal shape B4 uses when empty_universe_ok is not needed.

W1.description: W1 (surface walk): drives a real browser over a deployed STAGING app and asserts one declared behaviour per control. Outside the A-G family lettering, following PC1's precedent; found_by is sweep-family-E because W1 extends E1's machinery. Reuses E1's adapter seam verbatim - base_url_env, route_manifest_cmd, exclusions - and adds walk_manifest.

base_url_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the STAGING base URL. Never production: W1 clicks things, and a click in the pilot repo can approve a bill.

route_manifest_cmd.description: A command printing one route per line. The same adapter seam E1 uses [RT-9].

walk_manifest.description: Repo-relative path to the walk manifest: per screen, the controls and one assertion verb each.

exclusions.description: Screens excluded from the walk, each with a stated reason. Same shape as E1's.

detection_cadence.description: OPTIONAL. Scheduled human-instrument cadence (stack ADR-082 P1e): .github/workflows/detection-cadence.yml creates a fortnightly walkthrough-due issue and a monthly cross-family-review-due issue, both through the queue's single writer (scripts/improvement-queue.sh). Absence of this block is a clean no-op, not an error - the workflow never creates a cadence issue without a configured owner.

owner.description: GitHub login the detection-cadence workflow assigns cadence issues to.
